svg.title: Equation 10.6-3, 10.6-4, 10.6-5
svg.desc: LaTeX source: \begin{aligned} & L_{DR,m} = L_{DR,m - 1} + \frac{v_{NOD,m}^{n}T_{m}}{R_{Mh,m - 1}} = L_{DR,m - 1} + \frac{\Delta S_{N,m}^{n}}{R_{Mh,m - 1}}\qquad(10.6-3) \\ & \lambda_{DR,m} = \lambda_{DR,m - 1} + \frac{v_{EOD,m}^{n}T_{m}\sec L_{DR,m - 1}}{R_{Nh,m - 1}} = \lambda_{DR,m - 1} + \frac{\Delta S_{E,m}^{n}\sec L_{DR,m - 1}}{R_{Nh,m - 1}}\qquad(10.6-4) \\ & h_{DR,m} = h_{DR,m - 1} + v_{UOD,m}^{n}T_{m} = h_{DR,m - 1} + \Delta S_{U,m}^{n}\qquad(10.6-5) \end{aligned}
